objective: Build an evidence-backed, provider-neutral market-data provider inventory and capability scorecards for the P01-A universe without selecting a production provider.
scope: Inventory candidate multi-asset, crypto-specialist, exchange/direct and official macro/rates data sources
Document real-time, historical, order-book, derivatives and context-market coverage
Document streaming/REST delivery, timestamps, replay/history depth and public capacity/rate-limit information
Document publicly available licensing, redistribution, internal-use and SLA/support constraints
Identify suitability roles for primary, secondary, cross-validation and context-only use without making a final selection
Preserve Forex proxy-volume semantics from P01-A
Record unresolved commercial/licensing questions for P01-E and fallback questions for P01-F
out_of_scope: Select or contract a production market-data provider
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every capability claim has official_source_refs or is marked unknown
Forex data is not described as consolidated global spot volume unless substantiated
No final production provider is selected
No credentials or runtime integration are introduced
security_tests: No production data entitlement is implied by public documentation
Redistribution/internal-use constraints are explicitly carried forward
evidence: Official exchange/source documentation where direct-source class is discussed
rollback: Revert P01-B research artifacts and state/catalog reconciliation. No credentials, contracts or runtime integrations are created.
definition_of_done: Provider classes and candidate providers are documented
Coverage, delivery, historical, operational and licensing evidence are recorded
Unknowns are explicitly labeled for later workstreams
No final production provider is selected
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
